title: Iron veins as a natural wiring network on the Giza Plateau

tellings.quote: It all emanates from the core of the central pyramid and the Great Pyramid and it spreads all across the Giza plateau connecting all of these various structures.

plain: Veins of iron run out from the core of the Great Pyramid and the central pyramid at Giza and spread across the whole plateau, connecting its structures like natural wiring. Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher who says an alien told him the true purpose of the pyramids, tells Michels this; if true, it would mean the pyramids were built as parts of one connected machine.
